api_list.name: Get a Specific Quote
api_list.description: This endpoint fetches a specific quote using the provided 'id'.
api_list.code:
import requests

url = "https://motivational-content.p.rapidapi.com/quotes/4"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "motivational-content.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
api_list.convert_code:
import requests

url = "https://motivational-content.p.rapidapi.com/quotes/{id}"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "motivational-content.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())

api_list.convert_code:
import requests

url = "https://motivational-content.p.rapidapi.com/pics/{id}"

headers = {
            "X-RapidAPI-Key": "SIGN-UP-FOR-KEY",
            "X-RapidAPI-Host": "motivational-content.p.rapidapi.com"
        }

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
